headline: Public hearings on parking reductions at 61-69 Suffolk and 956 Dwight streets, a Pine Street zone change, and Comprehensive Plan revisions.
summary: Hearings cover parking reduction requests, a Pine Street zone change, and Comprehensive Plan revisions. The meeting also includes a fence height request at 230-232 Beech Street and a Peck School update.
